_comment: Provenance for the vendored Skeletonic CSS framework. Vendored rather than loaded from a CDN because the site's CSP is style-src 'self' — a third-party stylesheet host would be blocked, and widening the policy to admit one is a worse trade than checking in 5 KB.
_integration: Skeletonic wraps everything in @layer skeletonic. Unlayered CSS always beats layered CSS regardless of specificity, so the framework supplies consistent base styling for every HTML element while the site's own stylesheet — which ssg extracts unlayered from the layouts — keeps precedence. That is why adopting it does not require rewriting the existing design.
